register.labelZh: DEAL 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: deal in 可以說明店舖、公司或個人經常買賣哪類商品;deal with 則可以說明他們與哪些人或公司做生意。；deal somebody in 表示把某人包括在內;deal somebody out 則表示不把某人包括在活動或計劃內。；deal something out 可以表示把卡牌、門票、表格、食物或其他物品分派給多人。；deal with 可以表示協助顧客、應付難以處理的人,或處理投訴、故障和事件。
register.summaryEn: Deal in can describe the products that a shop, company or person regularly buys and sells. Deal with can describe the people or companies they do business with. Deal somebody in means that the person can join. Deal somebody out means that the person will not take part. Deal something out can describe distributing cards, tickets, forms, food or other items among several people. Deal with can describe helping a customer, managing a difficult person or taking action to handle a complaint, fault or incident.
